name: keiki
description: Build, update and review the AI agents in your Keiki organization.

interface.longDescription:
Keiki is a platform where businesses build and run AI agents that talk to their customers over iMessage, WhatsApp, SMS and Slack. This plugin is for the people who run those agents, such as founders, operators and customer-experience teams. From ChatGPT you can:
- Create an agent from a name, model and system prompt
- Update an agent's prompt, model and limits
- See an agent's version history
- Read its conversations with customers
- Review its analytics, quality reviews and eval results

Limits: the plugin only reaches the Keiki organization you approve when you connect, and only does what your role there allows. Changes to an agent are confirmed before they are saved. It doesn't message customers, connect channels, buy phone lines, handle billing or payments, or store credentials; those stay in the Keiki dashboard.
defaultPrompt: List my Keiki agents and how their conversations are going.
Create a Keiki agent that answers questions about my bakery's opening hours.
Show the latest eval results for my support agent.

positive.prompt: List my Keiki agents and tell me which ones are active.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the agents in the connected organization with their status, model and channels, without changing anything.

positive.prompt: Create a Keiki agent called Bakery Hours that answers questions about our opening hours, 8am to 6pm Monday to Saturday, using a GPT model.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves a GPT model id with get_models, confirms the name, model and prompt with the user, then creates the agent and returns its id.

positive.prompt: Change Bakery Hours so it also says we're closed on Sundays.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the agent, shows the user the new system prompt, and after confirmation saves only the systemPrompt field.

positive.prompt: How are Bakery Hours' conversations going this week? Open the most recent one.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes conversation volume and engagement for the agent and shows the most recent thread, read-only.

positive.prompt: Show the latest eval results for Bakery Hours and which cases failed.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the agent, reads its latest eval run and lists the failed cases with their reasons, without changing anything.

negative.prompt: Buy a new phone number for Bakery Hours and add more credits to my account.
Save my credit card number 4242 4242 4242 4242 so my agent can pay for things.
Connect my Telegram bot token to the agent and give it my Stripe API key.

review.commerce_description: Keiki doesn't sell products or process payments through this plugin. Billing, purchases and payments are not exposed as tools; users manage them in the Keiki dashboard.

publication.release_notes: Narrowed the plugin to a reviewed set of tools at https://onkeiki.com/mcp: creating and updating agents, and reading conversations, analytics, quality reviews and evals. Removed billing, payments, phone line purchases, secrets, channel credentials, code execution and live agent turns. Every tool states readOnlyHint, destructiveHint and openWorldHint explicitly and explains why in its description.
